answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 48252 Country: India Title: Dream Question: Once I saw myself near Kabah Sharif and noor was spreading. A man black in colour with ihram was saying that as Allah brought you here he will take you up from here. Answer ID: 48252 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1474/1131/B=11/1434) In-shaAllah, you shall be blessed with Hajj, and the person whose ihram is black his practice is against sunnah. One should not pay any attention towards such person. None knows where he or she will die. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
